items.topic: What interface modality should the onboarding use: a CLI-based interactive wizard (like yeoman/create-react-app), a local web UI (like the swarm-manager console), or a TUI (terminal UI with rich widgets)?

options.label: CLI interactive wizard (fastest to build, consistent with existing tools)
Local web UI served by an onboarding API (most beginner-friendly)
TUI with rich widgets like bubbletea (good middle ground)
Hybrid: CLI for setup steps, then opens web UI for configuration

items.freeform: Like all scenarios, as much logic as possible should be in the API. There should be both a friendly CLI **and** a UI that have the same functionality. This gives users flexibility

items.topic: What is the MVP scope for v1? Should it cover only initial first-run setup, or also serve as an ongoing configuration hub that users return to?

options.label: First-run wizard only — guide through initial setup, then hand off to individual tools
Ongoing configuration hub — a central place users always come back to for all settings
First-run wizard for v1, with a roadmap to evolve into a configuration hub

items.topic: How non-technical is the target user? Are we designing for someone who has never used a terminal, or someone comfortable with CLI but unfamiliar with Vrooli specifically?

options.label: Non-technical: no terminal experience, needs full GUI
Semi-technical: comfortable with terminal basics, needs guidance on Vrooli concepts
Developer new to Vrooli: understands tools, just needs Vrooli-specific walkthrough

items.topic: Which resources and scenarios should the onboarding cover in v1? The system has 46+ resources — should it guide through all enabled ones, or focus on a curated starter set?

options.label: Curated starter set of essential resources only
All enabled resources with guided categorization
Let users pick from a checklist of available resources

items.freeform: Curated starter set. Should include coding agents first (resource-claude-code, resource-codex, resource-opencode), then ai providers (resource-openrouter, resource-ollama), and maybe that's it for now
